global_cross_cutting_findings.claim: All 16 inventoried model DLLs are AMD64 PE (machine=0x8664), have no CLR directory, and their only static import is KERNEL32.dll.
version_strings is empty for all 16 model DLLs; no FileVersion/ProductVersion/ProductName resource strings exist in them.
global_cross_cutting_findings.source: pe-inventory version_strings={} for every model DLL

global_cross_cutting_findings.claim: No .h/.hpp/.c/.cpp/.def/.lib implementing the Dll* export wrapper exists in the two template directories or the searched E:/rflysimtools tree; only .p build helpers and a ctypes consumer exist.
No material binds any DLL to its generated ZIP/SLX/init revision. The e0 chain is itself inconsistent (SLX 11.8 vs ZIP 11.0).
No license or permitted-use statement for any vendor model DLL is recorded anywhere; redistribution is explicitly unconfirmed.
Every Dll* export except DllCreatModel is undecorated, so no calling convention is encoded or recorded; the Windows default could be cdecl or stdcall and the material does not decide.
global_cross_cutting_findings.source: pe-inventory export names; docs/plan/9-abi-environment-evidence.md:51 requires this field

global_cross_cutting_findings.claim: The vendor ctypes consumer is a conditional superset adapter: every symbol is configured under hasattr() guards, so the effective ABI per sample is a per-file subset, not a shared contract.

All 16 model DLLs export exactly one decorated C++ symbol, ?DllCreatModel@@YAXXZ, and no undecorated DllCreatModel. Under the documented MSVC mangling this encodes void __cdecl DllCreatModel(void); name-based resolution must therefore use the decorated string.
DllGetStep0 is absent from MultSILSwarm.dll only (15 of 16); the consumer's 0.001 fallback path is therefore exercised by at least one inventoried sample.

Collision input is exported under two different names across samples (DllInputColls in 2 DLLs, DllinCollision20d in 1) and SIL input likewise (DllInputSILs in 4, DllinSIL28d in 1); terrain input likewise (DllTerrainIn15d in 8, DllInputTerrain in 7). No single DLL exports both members of any of these pairs.

No inventoried model DLL exports both the legacy output-name family (DlloutputSensors/DlloutputGPS/DlloutModel3DInfo) and the modern family (DlloutHILSensor30d/DlloutHILGPS30d). Family is per-file, not per-product.

contradictions.statement: The same consumer declares DllInputColls as c_double[20] (lines 1237-1239) and then overwrites it as c_float[20] (lines 1294-1296). Element width is undecided.
contradictions.new_corroboration: DllinCollision20d (Exp2) confirms the length 20 but not the width; no material decides float vs double.
contradictions.resolution_requires: authoritative header/spec or an authorised sample built from that interface

contradictions.statement: The consumer checks DllInitPosAngStat at lines 1248/1255 but accesses DllInitPosAngState.
contradictions.new_evidence: DllInitPosAngStat is absent from all 18 inventoried PE files, so this is a real consumer-side defect, not a naming variant; it also means the DllInitPosAngState argtypes never get installed on that path.
contradictions.resolution_requires: authoritative header/spec; the correct export name is already established as DllInitPosAngState

contradictions.statement: The consumer configures DllInputDoubCtrls and the supplied sample calls sendInDoubCtrls(), but no inventoried model DLL exports that name (only DllinSIL28d exists, in Exp2 only). Either the sample targets a DLL outside the inventoried directory, or the legacy control path is dead in this population.
evidence: pe-inventory union of 31 export names over 16 model DLLs
contradictions.resolution_requires: the sample's actual dll_name argument plus the export table of that exact binary

contradictions.statement: DllOutCopterData is declared with argtypes=[double[32]] at construction, but a later wrapper method re-allocates the array and calls it with no arguments; a fixed-arity argtypes plus a zero-argument call cannot both be correct.
contradictions.resolution_requires: authoritative header/spec plus the consumer code beyond line 1307

contradictions.statement: Two distinct binaries share the filename Exp1_MinModelTemp.dll: the e0 template copy at E:/rflysimtools/RflySimAPIs/4.RflySimModel/1.BasicExps/e0_MinModelTemp/ (235520 B, SHA256 30747a8d47ca76ed3a2c751eac212102dde6a3ab4b29ba8eaae5926d416ca91b, the hash the G6 provenance chain is bound to) and the deployed copy at E:/rflysimtools/CopterSim/external/model/ (230912 B, SHA256 8134aab646adda098b7c98a4daa17278dbed7a626a1811e18ed1a88288fb6a46). No material explains the difference, and no material states which binary the SDK sample or the SITL batch path actually loads.
evidence: docs/plan/model-reference-provenance.md:17 asserts the SITL batch copies the template DLL into the model directory
contradictions.consequence: Any ABI statement keyed to 'the e0 DLL' is currently ambiguous between two binaries with different export families (the deployed copy is legacy-output-only; the template copy's export table has never been inventoried).
contradictions.resolution_requires: read-only PE inventory of the e0 template copy and, if present, the e1 template DLL, plus the model-directory deployment record

contradictions.statement: docs/coptersim-reconstruction.md:63 and docs/plan/model-reference-provenance-supplement.md:20 state that the model DLLs (per the supplement, specifically the e0 DLL) export both the legacy output names (DlloutputSensors, DlloutModel3DInfo) and the modern ones (DlloutHILSensor30d, DlloutVehileInfo60d) side by side. Over the 16 inventoried DLLs that is true only as a population statement: no single DLL exports both families. The per-DLL claim about the e0 DLL cannot be checked because the e0 template export table is not inventoried (c5).
evidence: pe-inventory family classification: 7 legacy-name DLLs, 8 modern-30d/60d DLLs, 3 with extended exports, zero DLLs with both families
contradictions.consequence: The statement must be re-scoped per file before it can be used for a loader design; issue #27 AC1 explicitly forbids substituting name similarity for a real ABI.
contradictions.resolution_requires: per-file export tables for every candidate sample, expressed as a versioned matrix rather than a population sentence

contradictions.statement: The e1 export-name evidence (docs/plan/model-reference-provenance-supplement.md:12) is a binary-string observation with no recorded file path, file size or SHA256, and it is the sole source for the claim that DllInitPosAngState is the correct name. The e1 SLX/ZIP/init hashes are recorded elsewhere but the e1 DLL hash is not.
contradictions.consequence: The strongest single piece of 'what the exports are' evidence is not reproducible from repository material alone; only its conclusion is recorded.
contradictions.resolution_requires: record the e1 DLL path/size/SHA256 and re-read its export table read-only, or cite the original observation command output
